title: Hempstead Lake State Park: Native Heritage Learning
summary: The Montaukett Indian Nation’s November 2022 newsletter invited the public to a Native American Heritage Month program at Hempstead Lake State Park.
address_label: Hempstead Lake State Park main entrance, 1000 Lake Drive, West Hempstead
ancestral_territory_note: The Montaukett Nation included Hempstead Lake in its 2022 heritage-month outreach.
why_this_matters: The Montaukett Nation’s own invitation connects Native history with public learning in Nassau County. It shows how a present-day community brings its culture and history to audiences beyond the East End.
introduction_title: An Invitation from the Montaukett Nation
introduction_content: In its November 1, 2022 newsletter, signed by Chief Robert Pharaoh, the Montaukett Indian Nation invited members, family, and friends to public educational experiences celebrating Native culture and heritage. Hempstead Lake State Park was listed for November 5.
history_content:
The Montaukett Nation’s invitation welcomed people to learn about Native culture and heritage at Hempstead Lake State Park. It was part of the Nation’s public outreach during Native American Heritage Month in 2022.

Today the park’s Environmental Education and Resiliency Center offers programs about the surrounding landscape. See the park calendar for upcoming events.
whereintheworld_content: Check New York State Parks for entrances, fees, and current programs at Hempstead Lake.
